column2: [intro]
I'm not complicated, I'm born to have fun,
My little touch of madness, no one can shun.
I'm like a star, shining bright in hue,
My identity, it shows in everything I do.
Hey my friend, tell me who you really are,
What makes you stand out, a shining star?
In this song, we want to know it all,
What shapes your identity every nightfall?
I'm a fan of jokes, a lover of wordplay,
In French or in English, I’m versatile every day.
My voice is my tool, to make people grin,
And that’s my trademark, since I was a kid, it's been.
Hey my friend, tell me who you really are,
What makes you stand out, a shining star?
In this song, we want to know it all,
What shapes your identity every nightfall?
[ solo ]
And there you have it, my friend, our song’s complete,
I hope it echoes in your heart, a melody sweet.
For you alone know who you truly are,
Keep shining, keep laughing, be yourself, a star.
[outro]
